realism_explanation: You cover React and its build tooling well, and two preferred lines — a public portfolio and Khmer — are strong matches. The graduation-year mismatch, and the missing internship and testing experience, are the main risks.

job.title: Frontend Engineer - Graduate Programme 2027
job.education_required: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering or closely related, graduating 2026 or 2027
job.sponsors_visa_source_line: Successful international candidates are sponsored for a Singapore Employment Pass under Meridian's graduate mobility scheme, subject to Ministry of Manpower approval.

requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related discipline, graduating in 2026 or 2027
Hands-on experience with React and its ecosystem
Experience with modern build tooling such as Vite or Webpack
Working knowledge of automated testing with Jest, Vitest or React Testing Library
Familiarity with version control workflows in Git
At least one internship or industrial attachment in a software engineering team
Exposure to CSS-in-JS or utility-first CSS frameworks such as Tailwind
Demonstrated interest in accessibility and performance engineering
Contributions to open-source projects or a public portfolio
An additional language relevant to our regional customers, such as Khmer, Thai or Bahasa Indonesia

resume.candidate_summary: Junior ICT undergraduate at the American University of Phnom Penh (GPA 3.5+) with basic hands-on experience in Java and web development through academic projects. Eager to learn, take direction, and grow in a professional frontend and backend environment. Looking for an internship opportunity.

education.degree: Bachelor in Information and Communication Technologies (Software Development & Project Management)

evidence.source_line: Password Encryption System (Python): implemented a Python-based encryption system for secure storage and validation of user credentials.
Student Tracking System (Java): built a full-stack Java application with a frontend interface, using object-oriented programming and automated CSV export to streamline attendance record-keeping.
Personal Portfolio Website (HTML, CSS, JavaScript): delivered a fully responsive, mobile-friendly portfolio showcasing projects across all screen sizes. (sole developer)
MovieFlix - Movie Search Web App (Vite + React): built a real-time movie discovery platform with dynamic search, integrating a live movie API with React state management and a Vite build pipeline.
Sudoku Solver - Backtracking & MRV Heuristic (Java): implemented two Java Sudoku solvers and compared their performance, showing how the MRV heuristic reduces recursion depth.
Bachelor in Information and Communication Technologies, American University of Phnom Penh, expected 2028, GPA 3.5+ (Junior standing). Specialization in Software Development and Project Management.

priority_actions.text: Get any internship, even a short one, before applying — this listing explicitly requires it and it is currently your biggest gap.
Learn the basics of one testing library (Jest or Vitest) and add a line about it — even a small test suite on an existing project would help.
Confirm the programme's graduation-year requirement directly with Meridian — some graduate schemes flex by a year for strong candidates.
